_comment: Simplified Chinese texts for the German table fan_inkshadow. Keys are the English text; keys with %s or %d are patterns. Kept by hand; check with python3 tools/i18n/check_lang.py zh_CN.

strings.%s counts the fence posts. Twice. One is: %s数篱笆桩。数了两遍。少了一根。
strings.%s digs up a few coins and drops them at: %s刨出几枚硬币丢在你脚边。%d金币！
strings.%s eats something off the path. It seems: %s吃了路上的什么东西。看起来没事。大概。
%s瞪着一丛灌木，好像它欠了钱。
%s躲在你靴子后面，躲一片叶子。
%s跟上步伐，平静得像一口合上的棺材。
strings.%s mutters the names of everyone you let: %s念叨着你让倒下的每个名字。你的也在名单上。
strings.%s nods at strangers as if they owe it a: %s朝陌生人点头，好像他们欠它一个鞠躬。
strings.%s plants its feet. Nothing is attacking: %s站稳脚跟。没人进攻。它还是站稳了。
strings.%s runs ahead, runs back, and pretends i: %s跑到前面，又跑回来，假装从没离开。
strings.%s sniffs a grave marker and looks very: %s嗅了嗅一块墓碑，看上去非常感兴趣。
strings.%s steps on your heel. Twice. On purpose: %s踩了你的脚后跟。两次。故意的。
strings.%s steps on your shadow so nobody sees i: %s踩住你的影子，好让别人看不见。
strings.%s struts like it won the last battle al: %s昂首阔步，好像上一场是它独自打赢的。
%s跟在你身后有点太近了。像刀一样。
strings.%s walks exactly in your footprints, jus: %s完全踩着你的脚印走，以防万一。
